svg.title: thermal-smoky
svg.desc: Preview of the thermal-smoky Neovim colourscheme: a TypeScript sample on a smoky black background with gray body text and heat-gradient accents, followed by the heat ramp, terminal ANSI palette and Slack sidebar colours.
svg.text: // thresholds are in celsius, not kelvin
heat ramp — cold to white hot
terminal — ANSI 0 to 15, shared with the ghostty theme
slack sidebar — column, hover menu, active, active text, hover, text, presence, badge
